tools.name: get_factory_profile
tools.description: Published identity, capabilities, quality, boundaries, and contact facts for Shanglan, a women's clothing factory in Shenzhen. Optional section filter. Does not include prices, stock, certifications, or a WhatsApp number.

tools.name: lookup_production_terms
tools.description: Look up one published commercial term: moq, sampling, revisions, bulk, shipping, response, or quality. Use all for every term. Ranges are copied from the site with their start conditions. This does not reserve capacity or promise a ship date.

tools.name: search_styles
tools.description: Search the published women's development styles by keyword, style code (SY001), or category (woven, denim, knit). Returns names, excerpts, and public URLs. A style code that is not on the site is an error. These are development references, not priced stock.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search published FAQ answers and the MOQ, timeline, and low-MOQ guide passages. The query must contain a real word. An unknown topic returns an empty match list, not a guessed answer.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry_checklist
tools.description: Turn what the buyer already has into a checklist for the public quote form. Requires at least one real starting point: tech pack, sketch, reference photos, sample garment, or a published style code. Does not submit the inquiry or contact the factory.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_styles" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_styles · Private data: get_factory_profile, prepare_inquiry_checklist · Public sink: prepare_inquiry_checklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_styles · Private data: get_factory_profile, prepare_inquiry_checklist · Public sink: prepare_inquiry_checklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
